name: Axiom Systems Neural Dead Drop NDD-2
product_name: Axiom Systems Neural Dead Drop NDD-2
description: A concealed device that stores encrypted data accessible only through a specific neural interface authentication. The NDD-2 can be hidden anywhere — embedded in a wall, buried underground, or concealed in everyday objects — and appears as inert material to all scanning methods. When an authorized neural interface comes within 10 cm, the device authenticates the user's neural signature and releases the stored data directly to their implant. The transfer is invisible to external monitoring and leaves no trace on the recipient's interface after the data is read. Axiom designed it for intelligence operations where physical document exchange or electronic transmission are too risky.

specifications.concealment: Appears inert to all scanning methods

story_hooks: A player character brushes against a wall and their neural interface receives an unexpected data payload — someone planted an NDD-2 keyed to their specific neural signature with a message meant only for them.
A network of NDD-2 devices has been discovered embedded in public infrastructure across Tier 3 — someone has built a city-wide dead drop network for intelligence exchange.

physical_description.visual_profile: A featureless, inert-looking micro-device resembling a flattened ceramic wafer or industrial sensor component. Deliberately nondescript to avoid attention or recognition. When embedded, appears as part of surrounding material — indistinguishable from concrete, drywall, or industrial composite.
physical_description.dimensions: 20mm × 10mm × 5mm (roughly the size of a large postage stamp, thickness of two credit cards stacked)
physical_description.weight_description: Negligible — under 3 grams, instantly pocketable or embeddable without detection
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced silicate composite with inert ceramic housing
physical_description.finish: Matte, non-reflective surface with subtle micro-texture to resist optical scanning. Designed to blend seamlessly into concrete, plaster, or industrial materials when embedded.
physical_description.color_scheme: Neutral gray-beige primary with barely-visible charcoal circuit tracery visible only under magnification. No branding visible on surface.
physical_description.interface_elements: No external interface — all interaction is neural. Single microscopic contact pad on underside (0.5mm) for optional hardline diagnostics. No LED indicators, screens, or mechanical components.
distinctive_features: Perfectly flat, featureless face designed to evade visual inspection
Micro-etched serial number on rear (requires magnification to read)
Imperceptible haptic response when neural authentication succeeds
Barely-visible manufacturing flaw (intentional) to distinguish from surveillance devices
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Axiom Systems corporate sigil (Φ enclosed in a circuit ring) laser-etched on reverse in 2mm font. Model identifier 'NDD-2' in microscopic print. GLMZ regulatory stamp present but degraded-looking.
physical_description.condition_typical: Appears weathered or aged even when new — designed to look like forgotten hardware or industrial debris. In embedded form, indistinguishable from wall/concrete texture.
